verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com for headless use. Bearer API tokens are explicitly intended for 'customer or internal automation', with scoped permissions, dated version pinning, cursor pagination and an official npm SDK, which together allow non-interactive scripted runs. However, nothing shows that the IT-specific capabilities (device management, identity/access, inventory) are reachable through this API, and there is no CI-specific guidance or CLI, so most IT automation shown runs inside Rippling's own workflow engine. Missing for 10: evidence of IT-module (device/identity/inventory) API endpoints, a CLI or CI integration docs/examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
